original_question: On which chromosome is the binding cassette transporter gene associated with Dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria located?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the binding cassette transporter gene associated with Dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria located?
final_qi.long_answer: Dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria can result from pathogenic variants in the ATP-binding cassette transporter gene ABCB6. ABCB6 is mapped to the long arm of chromosome 2 (cytogenetic band 2q35-q36.3), making chromosome 2 the chromosomal location associated with this disorder.
